Normally, these spaces are sold and/or recovered to/from other companies or other related parties, based on their actual use.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Purchase-sale of financial assets</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">Cash surplus are usually invested in several instruments that may include those issued by related companies acquired at issuance or from unrelated third parties through transactions in the secondary market.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Investment in investment funds managed by BACS</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The Group invests parts of liquid funds in mutual funds managed by BACS among other entities.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Borrowings </strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">In the normal course of its activities, the Group enters into diverse loan agreements or credit facilities between the group&#8217;s companies and/or other related parties. These borrowings accrue interests at market rates.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Financial and service operations with BHSA</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The Group works with several financial entities in the Argentine market for operations including, but not limited to, credit, investment, purchase and sale of securities and financial derivatives. Such entities include BHSA and its subsidiaries. BHSA and BACS usually act as underwriters in Capital Market transactions. In addition, we have entered into agreements with BHSA, which provides collection services for our shopping malls.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>San Bernardo lease </strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><ix:nonNumeric id="fid_26967" name="cresud:SanBernardoLeaseDescription" contextRef="From2024-07-01to2025-06-30">The Company leased in January 2019 a farm in the Province of C&#243;rdoba owned by San Bernardo de C&#243;rdoba S.A. (formerly Isaac Elsztain e hijos S.C.A), continuing the lease held in August 2015, for a fraction of 10,896 hectares</ix:nonNumeric>.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The lease was agreed for 12,590 hectares and the price was set at the amount of pesos equivalent to 2.5 kg of meat per hectare. The price of meat will be set taking into account the price per kilo of meat determined by the I.N.M.L (cattle index of the Liniers Market) reported on the website of said Market. Additionally, a production prize equivalent to 15% of the kilos produced in excess of 175,000 was agreed for the total of the existing property.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong>Consulting Agreement</strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">In accordance with the terms of the Consulting Agreement, in force as from November 7, 1994, and its amendments, CAMSA provides us with advisory services on matters related to activities and investments included agricultural, real estate, financial and hotel operations, among others. <ix:nonNumeric id="fid_26968" name="cresud:OwnershipInterestPercentage" contextRef="From2024-07-01to2025-06-30">An 85% of the capital stock of CAMSA is held by one of our shareholders and President of our Board of Directors, while the remaining 15% of the capital stock is owned by our First Vice President</ix:nonNumeric>.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">Based on the terms and conditions of the Consulting Agreement, CAMSA provides us with the following services:</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#8226;&#160; advise in relation to investing in all aspects of the agricultural business, real estate, financial, and hotel operations, among others, and business proposals;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#8226;&#160; acts on behalf of our company in such transactions, negotiating prices, terms and conditions and other terms of each transaction; and </p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#8226;&#160; provides advisory services on investments in securities related to such transactions.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">As regards the Consulting Agreement, in consideration for its services we pay CAMSA an annual fee equal to 10% of our annual net income after tax from our separate statement of income. During the years ended as of June 30, 2025, 2024 and 2023, ARS (<ix:nonFraction id="fid_26969" name="cresud:FeeServices" contextRef="From2024-07-01to2025-06-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" unitRef="USD" decimals="0">9,081</ix:nonFraction>), ARS (<ix:nonFraction id="fid_26971" name="cresud:FeeServices" contextRef="From2023-07-01to2024-06-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" unitRef="ARS" decimals="0">12,945</ix:nonFraction>) and ARS (<ix:nonFraction id="fid_26970" name="cresud:FeeServices" contextRef="From2022-07-01to2023-06-30" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" unitRef="USD" decimals="0">24,823</ix:nonFraction>) were recognized in results for this concept, respectively.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The Consulting Agreement can be revoked by any of the parties upon prior written notice that should not exceed 60 days. If we revoke the Consulting Agreement without cause, we will be liable to pay CAMSA twice the average fee amounts paid for management services during the two fiscal years preceding such revocation.</p></ix:continuation><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><table style="border-spacing:0;font:10pt times new The main features of the issue are detailed below:</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#8226; Series XLIX Notes <ix:nonNumeric id="fid_26984" name="cresud:DescriptionOfInterestPayable" contextRef="From2025-09-01to2025-09-02_cresud_SeriesXLIXNotesMember">denominated in dollars for an amount of USD 31.3 million, bearing interest at a fixed annual rate of 7.25%, payable semi-annually. The principal will be made in one installment, on the maturity date, September 2, 2027. The issue price was 100% of the nominal value</ix:nonNumeric>.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;"><strong><span style="text-decoration:underline">Acquisition of the Al Oeste Shopping - IRSA</span></strong></p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">On September 17, 2025, we informed that IRSA has acquired &#8220;Al Oeste&#8221; shopping mall through the signing of the deed and the transfer of operations. This property is located at the intersection of Luis G&#252;emes and Presidente Per&#243;n Avenues, in the town of Haedo, Mor&#243;n district, west of Greater Buenos Aires.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The shopping mall is currently operating below its potential, and within the framework of the Company&#8217;s development plan to create opportunities in different districts of the Province of Buenos Aires, it is planned to be converted into an outlet center to be relaunched during next year.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#8220;<ix:nonNumeric id="fid_26985" name="cresud:AcquiredBusinessDescription" contextRef="From2025-09-01to2025-09-17_cresud_AcquisitionOfTheAlOesteShoppingIRSAMember">Al Oeste Shopping&#8221; has approximately 20,000 GLA sqm, including 40 stores, 6 food court units, 5 padel courts, 14 cinema theaters, and 1,075 parking spaces. In addition, it has an expansion potential of 12,000 GLA sqm</ix:nonNumeric>.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; text-align:justify;">&#160;&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">The purchase price was USD <ix:nonFraction id="fid_26986" name="cresud:PurchasePriceOfAcquiredBusiness" contextRef="From2025-09-01to2025-09-17_cresud_AcquisitionOfTheAlOesteShoppingIRSAMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" unitRef="ARS" decimals="-6" scale="6">9</ix:nonFraction> million, of which USD <ix:nonFraction id="fid_26987" name="cresud:PaymentPiadToDateForAcquiringBusiness" contextRef="From2025-09-01to2025-09-17_cresud_AcquisitionOfTheAlOesteShoppingIRSAMember" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" unitRef="ARS" decimals="-5" scale="6">4.5</ix:nonFraction> million has been paid to date. The remaining balance will be paid in four annual installments.</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt; FONT-FAMILY: times new roman; MARGIN: 0px; TEXT-INDENT: 45px; text-align:justify;">&#160;</p><p style="FONT-SIZE: 10pt;
